caption:
Friday message for your element 📱 Swipe to find yours.

Today is Yang Metal over Fire: a sharp blade in summer heat. Great for clear decisions; go gentle with your words.

Your element is the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find it free at the link in bio.

Comment your element and your Friday plan.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #zodiacsigns #fengshui #selfawareness #bazi #fourpillars #chineseastrology #fridayfeeling
day_line: A raw blade in the full summer canopy. Sharp and hot: good for clear decisions, careful with words.

lines.Yang Wood: A last-minute task lands today. Do it well, then log off on time.
lines.Yin Wood: Dress a little sharper today. Someone important remembers first impressions.
lines.Yang Fire: Say yes to Friday plans. A useful contact might be there. Your budget might not.
lines.Yin Fire: Payday maths day. Move some into savings before the weekend sales find you.
lines.Yang Earth: Weekend mood starts early. Plan something fun, but keep today's promises first.
lines.Yin Earth: You'll want to correct everyone today. Choose the one correction that matters.
lines.Yang Metal: Your squad is strong today. Plan the weekend before it becomes a 40-message debate.
lines.Yin Metal: Friendly competition at work or the gym today. Win it, then share your tip.
lines.Yang Water: Your gut is right about someone today. Keep it to yourself for now.
lines.Yin Water: Let someone treat you today. Say thank you, not 'aiyah, no need'.
